skill_name: Write a 150-word essay on the health benefits of eating fruits and vegetables.
workflow: Eating a variety of fruits and vegetables is essential for maintaining good health. Fruits and vegetables provide essential vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants needed to keep our bodies functioning properly. For example, leafy green veggies, such as spinach and kale, have a high concentration of antioxidants, which help to reduce free radical damage and protect us from disease.
